voice.welcome: Welcome to Sound Painting. Pick a sound, then paint what you hear!
voice.calm-prompt: Glide slowly. Make a peaceful river of color.
voice.bounce-prompt: Hop, loop, and tap to make a bouncy beat!
voice.sparkle-prompt: Swish fast and make the stars sing!
voice.empty: Touch the dark canvas and let your finger make music.
voice.replay: Now watch your painting play itself!
voice.clear: A fresh canvas, ready for a new song.
voice.saved: Your painting is safe on this device.
voice.done: Beautiful! You made music we can see.
